grades.quote: Restricted Privilege LeVel enable (RPLV) for the page table. When RPLV=0, the page table entry can be accessed by any program whose privilege level is not lower than PLV; when RPLV=1, the page table entry can only be accessed by programs whose privilege level is equal to PLV.
grades.reason: Directly explains how RPLV changes LA64 mapping access from a privilege threshold to exact PLV equality.
Generic contents headings provide no RPLV or TLB privilege-check explanation.
